title: Sun Study — Duplex (Vancouver)
description: Place the Duplex at a notional Vancouver site (49.28°N, -123.12°W) and drive a SunStudy with an AnnualSunPlayer. Scrub the time-of-day slider to watch shadows sweep across the building; toggle Day vs Year to playback either a single day or a full Jan-to-Dec sun-angle envelope. The directional 'sun' light's azimuth, altitude, colour, and intensity all derive from the NOAA Solar Position Algorithm — same math that powers daylight-factor compliance reports (LEED EQ Credit 8.1, BREEAM Hea 01, EN 17037).
